title: MailboxRole manually impl Serialize/Deserialize when derive + strum or a shared macro would suffice
description: MailboxRole in mailbox.rs manually implements Serialize, Deserialize (via a custom Visitor), and Display. The same pattern exists in submission.rs behind impl_string_enum_serde!. In idiomatic Rust, shared serde behavior for string-keyed enums with a catch-all variant lives in a shared private macro or helper. The manual impl is not wrong, but it diverges from the macro pattern introduced in submission.rs. A serious Rust practitioner would expect the pattern to be shared: move macro to pub(crate) module, apply it to MailboxRole.
